title_en: Can Fried Chicken Find You in a Park? 🍗 #shorts
description_en: Chimaek by the Han River: chicken, beer, and a delivery rider who finds your exact picnic blanket at midnight. Learn 치맥 (chicken + beer) and 배달 왔습니다 (your delivery is here). Stock footage: Pexels (free license)
